newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 to $10 lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 to $10 lower.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $5 to $10 lower Wednesday on the heels of a weak performance in London overnight, traders said.
LIFFE cocoa futures were lower in light trading, with July down five stg at the midday break at 1,008 stg a tonne and September off four stg at 1,027 stg.

Tuesday, New York cocoa futures ended most firmer in switch-dominated activity. Spot July closed up $5 at $1,435 a tonne after trading from $1,442 to $1,425. September settled $6 higher at $1,477, with the rest up $5 to off $1.
Technically, traders pegged near-term July support at $1,423 to $1,20, with resistance at $1,442 to $1,447. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodity Desk 212 859 1640))
